title: Two
html_source: The cab-drawing horses, “full as a tick” now after feeding from their nosebags in the previous episode.

anchor.prefix:
after I read it in the bath? He patted his waistcoatpocket. There all right. Dear Henry fled. Before my patience are exhausted. 

 National school. Meade's yard. The hazard. Only
anchor.suffix:
there now. Nodding. Full as a tick. Too much bone in their skulls. The other trotting round with a fare. An hour ago I was passing there. The jarvies raised their hats.
